name: matrix-altview
description: /matrix runs the AltView version: the rain takes over the screen and any key leaves it (the old fullscreen plugin only left on q or Esc, so an x would have left it running). Isolated HOME, hub off, setup marked done so the first-run wizard stays out of the way.

config.command: bash -lc 'H=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$H/.kollab"; printf "%s" "{\"plugins\":{\"hub\":{\"enabled\":false}},\"application\":{\"setup_completed\":true}}" > "$H/.kollab/config.json"; source .venv/bin/activate 2>/dev/null; HOME="$H" KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING=1 python main.py --no-daemon'

steps.description: the prompt is hidden while the rain runs
an ordinary key (not q or Esc) returns to the prompt
